name: Berserker

source.note: The 2024 Berserker. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Bloodied Frenzy is text only (the engine's Advantage modifiers can't ask whether the creature is Bloodied).

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.summary: While Bloodied it has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
traits.text: Once the berserker is Bloodied, it has Advantage on its attack rolls and saving throws.

summary: A hunter or deserter gone wild: wades in with a greataxe and fights harder the more it bleeds.
